note: Beside the loader case curation_toml/identity-edition-split-edition-assigned-to-two-split-variants-refused: two splits of one native variant are allowed while their editions are disjoint, and each takes its own edition.
fails_if: the register loader refuses a second `[[identity.edition_split]]` of the same native variant even when its editions are disjoint, or `compile_edition_splits` applies only one split per native variant

sources.description: Variant 2 of register 1 delivers SHARED (variable 5) in editions '2007' (CVID 20) and '2007-12-31' (CVID 21).
